title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode1 A Melody That Doesn't Connect

meta.Episode: Episode1 — A Melody That Doesn't Connect
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try having Miku sing this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, this isn't right either...
I'm having so much trouble getting it to sound the way I want...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku.
It's been a while since I decided to try making my own music, but I can't seem to produce anything good for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's written some really incredible songs for us already, while I...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, now's not the time for that.
I mean, I knew this wasn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just have to work at my own pace until I have a song that I feel satisfied with. Then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we'll be able to sing together like that one time.
bgm_area00001
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late, everyone.
It took longer than expected to write my entry into the class log.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika, hello.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were just watching the video of your performance at Shibuya Festa! The crowd seemed so into it! You girls have really been on fire lately!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the show you did with anemone was absolutely astounding.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We really gave it everything we had that time... It almost felt like each note shined, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally know what you mean!
Before the show, the tension felt kinda different compared to normal...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And things were completely different during it! I could hear the audience talking and stuff like always, but I was way more focused on the show itself...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You girls did practice quite a bit.
It seems that your hard work paid off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I agree.
Some people in the crowd even said how our show was the best they'd seen in a while.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was nice to get more of a chance to interact with them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Speaking of which, didn't you girls initially decide to play at a different live house so you could get Leo/need's name out there more?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe you accomplished your mission, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
Things have been going pretty well for us. But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't stop. We have to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We reached the ticket quotas for our last couple shows pretty quickly, which is nice since it's clear that more people are coming to see us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But our goal is to go pro.
Not only do we still have to become better performers, we have to keep convincing more and more people to come hear us play.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we played in more big events, like Shibuya Festa? That seems like an easy way to get ourselves in front of a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not a bad idea, but we won't have many opportunities to play at those kinds of events...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right... And we were only able to play at Shibuya Festa because there just happened to be one slot left when I called. It might not be so easy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Then, do we just need to keep playing in as many shows as we can?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What's wrong, KAITO?
You look like you have something to say.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If name recognition is what you're after, I don't think you have to only do shows...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, he's right!
Shiho, you even said that there's more than one way to get people to listen to our music!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, are you referring to...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. There are a lot of ways to go pro, but they all involve getting people to start listening to our music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That includes playing at different live houses, starting a band account to post videos, and all sorts of other stuff...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Videos! That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean we're finally gonna make an official Leo/need account?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun!!!
Oh, can I help! Pretty please♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we're going to need to edit our videos before uploading them, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine with that idea, but we'll have to give it some thought since I don't think any of us have much experience with this stuff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I'll try learning how.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As long as I have the software to do it, I think I can figure out how to cut, trim and edit videos for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was also thinking about how to actually start our channel since there will probably be a process to figure out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The videos I make may not end up being the best, but if it means even a few more people will listen to our songs, that will be worth the effort...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So...
I'd like to do what I can for this band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...was sooo cool!
You're the best, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami. We really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not as good at this stuff as you, Honami, so I don't how much I'll be able to help. But I want to do what I can. Feel free to ask for help if you ever think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! I will!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Honami's such an amazing person...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Between putting together schedules for us and making our flyer for Shibuya Festa, she does so much for us...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Leo/need's official channel's really happening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... But for now, we need to practice. We can talk later about how we're gonna shoot each video and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially if it means we'll be uploading all the new songs we come up with...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which means I need to write more songs that people will like!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki always seems to have so much fun writing songs for us...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(It's not that easy...
I mean, she went through a lot with that last one.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If I can learn to write songs for us, it'll help reduce the work Saki has to do...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, I'm struggling to write even one that I feel satisfied with. At this rate, I won't be able to help us at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (For the time being, I need to finish working on my current song. I'll mention it to the others when I have something that I feel good about...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Then, I can say that I gave songwriting a try...)
